# Luka Pataky named to ELG 40 Under 40 Class of 2027


September 21, 2026


Bragg is proud to share the news that


**Luka Pataky** – EVP, AI & Innovation, has been named to the


[Emerging Leaders of Gaming](https://theinnovationgroup.com/emerging-leaders-gaming/) (ELG) 40 Under 40 Class of 2027!


Selected by the ELG Selection Committee, the 40 Under 40 recognises the gaming industry’s most promising next-generation leaders. The programme, run by


**The Innovation Group** in partnership with


**Global Gaming Business** and


**iGaming Business** , conducts an industrywide search each year to identify the executives shaping gaming’s future.


The recognition reflects the work Luka leads at bragg in AI and innovation, and the role that talent plays in driving the business forward across regulated markets worldwide.


Proud to have Luka on the bragg team!
